components.css: .ds-role {font-family:Manrope,sans-serif;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:24px;padding:24px 0;min-height:106px;border-top:1px solid #c5d8c9;background:#edf5ee;color:#163e32;text-decoration:none;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out;} .ds-role strong {display:block;font-size:22px;line-height:1.4;font-weight:700;} .ds-role small {display:block;margin-top:6px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;color:#48675c;} .ds-role svg {flex-shrink:0;} .ds-role:hover {background:#dfecdf;}a:focus-visible {outline:3px solid #226c4f;outline-offset:5px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-role{transition:none;}}

narrative.overview: Typography, whitespace and clear rows make participation approachable. This records the implemented homepage and its homepage-specific navigation treatments; it does not redefine dashboard styling. The direction was delegated and implemented in code, without an approved visual comp.
keyCharacteristics: Flat white and mint surfaces with deep green text.
Warm yellow for the explanatory action.
dos: Do preserve equal role visibility and clear keyboard focus.
Do keep food sharing and waste collection visually and verbally understandable as separate activities.
donts: Don't apply this homepage scope to dashboards without a separate design decision.
Don't invent availability, approval status or impact figures.
